fields.label: Definition
Grant
fields.value: Approval permits repeated invocations by this principal (including every assigned key) without another prompt.

fields.label: Privileges
fields.value: Commands run as the daemon's Unix user with permission to gain privileges through sudo or other setuid helpers (no_new_privs is disabled). This grant permits repeated privileged invocations without another command approval. Sudo still enforces sudoers and can request passwords through zond; passwords are not stored. Review the executable, its configuration and its child processes, including package build scripts.

fields.label: Expansion
fields.value: Quoted pieces are literal text; ${name} is a binding. Pieces joined with + form one argument. No shell, word splitting, globbing or recursive expansion.

fields.label: mode: enumeration
fields.value: Exactly one of ["daily","weekly"]. Case-sensitive literal values; validated on every invocation.

fields.label: repo: repository-name
fields.value: 1–100 ASCII letters, digits, dots, underscores or hyphens; starts with a letter or digit. Full match: [A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,99}. Validated on every invocation; does not check repository existence.

fields.label: view: view
fields.value:
Choose one named row; its fields are supplied together. No other combinations are permitted. Validated on every invocation.
"balances" -> resource="balances", market="portfolio"
"positions" -> resource="positions", market="usdm"

fields.label: symbol: symbol
fields.value: Printable ASCII text, 2–20 bytes, matching the entire regular expression "[A-Z0-9]+". Validated on every invocation; values are never expanded again.

fields.label: count: count
fields.value: Unsigned decimal integer from 0 through 18446744073709551615, inclusive. Canonical digits only: no sign, leading zeros (except 0), whitespace or overflow.
